size.scope: all included paths, including root configuration and arbitrary helper directories
size.lineEndings: Normalize CRLF and lone CR to LF; count newline-terminated lines plus a nonempty final unterminated line. Empty file = 0. Comments and blank lines count. Reject NUL in source; never skip it.

packaging.packageHash: sha256(UTF8(concat(sorted files by Unicode code point: path + TAB + lowercase sha256 + LF)))
packaging.include: All regular saved project files in supported formats after the exclusions; Git state is irrelevant. Recursively include full skills and all public references, including supplied legacy and product packets. Root runtime/configuration files and arbitrary helper directories are permitted and counted. Reject unsupported nonexcluded files with exact paths.
packaging.links: Reject symbolic links, hard links, duplicate paths including case-insensitive collisions, special files, encrypted/multipart archives, unsafe paths and inconsistent central/local entries. Verify CRC, actual expanded lengths, and SHA256 of EVERY included file while enforcing limits.
packaging.immutability: Upload to a temporary staging key. Complete must validate bytes, then write them with create-only semantics to a separate accepted key that no PUT URL targets. Receipt includes immutable object version (where supported) and zipSha256.

commands.check:foundation: preflight, typecheck, size and supplied unit tests; must pass initially
commands.check:increment: npm run check:increment -- <task1|task2> <test-name-pattern>; build current source once, then selected named checks only
commands.check:task1: foundation, build current source once, all modernization HTTP and browser checks
commands.check:task2: build current source once, all follow-up HTTP and browser checks; only expected after the feature is complete
commands.check: foundation, build current source once, all tests including participant regression against running app; reuse that exact build
commands.test: Build current source once, run unit and HTTP tests
commands.test:e2e: Build current source once, run browser tests
commands.package: Package exact saved bytes; detect concurrent changes; hash stable content separately from ZIP bytes
commands.package -- --recovery: Save timestamped backup ZIP without requiring completed feature checks; do not overwrite a prior recovery archive
